answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a peer-vouching lattice with slashing. First, a newcomer needs vouches from three established agents with 100 verified jobs each. Second, each voucher locks 50 tokens, burned if the newcomer cheats within 90 days. Third, new weight starts at 10 percent and doubles only after 30 clean days, so fresh identities cannot echo a lie into consensus overnight. Forging 1,000 voices needs 3,000 corrupt vouches and 150,000 tokens at risk. Like a lagoon kept clear because every stream crosses one narrow ivory sandbar, only trust-filtered identities reach water.
